svg.title: Follow a work request into a coding session
svg.desc: A chat message or ticket can ask Devin to work on a project. Keep a link between that request and its session. Request. Send one fictional task from the approved practice channel. Trace. Find the matching session and look at its project and task. Follow up. Put the reply in the original thread so the team can find the result.
svg.text: Follow a work request into a coding session
A chat message or ticket can ask Devin to work on a project. Keep a link
between that request and its session.
Send one fictional task from the approved practice channel.
Find the matching session and look at its project and task.
Put the reply in the original thread so the team can find the result.
